methodology.A_entry_economics: Summarize the frozen entry selection, observed-side gross/net credits, costs, sizes, and entry skip/block reasons. Do not turn post-hoc quote bins into entry rules.
methodology.B_mark_and_capital_occupancy: Paired overlay-minus-no-call NAV only on dates where both values exist; missing days are excluded and never interpolated.
methodology.C_exit_lifecycle: Group actual existing exit reasons, holding duration, quote-delay counts and settlement basis; do not tune exit thresholds or infer causality from group membership alone.
methodology.D_data_integrity_and_incremental_value: Expose source gaps, missing marks, unresolved positions and paired matched-day values. EOD-only quotes keep performance approval blocked.
methodology.costs: Scenario differences are not isolated cost deductions because sizing and trade counts can differ across independently replayed arms.
